channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Em audiência nos EUA, Paulo Figueiredo dirá que tarifaço favorece Lula
item.description: Journalist Paulo Figueiredo stated in prepared testimony for a U.S. public hearing on July 6 that the proposed 25% tariff on Brazilian goods under Section 301 of the USTR would wrongly target Brazilian exporters, companies, and American consumers without affecting the officials responsible for triggering the investigation. He argued the tariff could politically benefit President Lula by turning anti-U.S. sentiment into domestic patriotism and weakening Brazil-Washington ties, aligning with Lula’s foreign policy goals. Figueiredo advocated instead for reviving targeted individual sanctions against specific officials — such as Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes — as a more effective and less economically harmful measure.

item.title: Flávio diz que atrito com Michelle é “página virada” em Goiás
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated that his disagreement with former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro is a 'closed chapter.' He attended the Caminhada da Fé in Goiás, emphasizing the religious nature of his visit and mentioning a meeting with his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, in Brasília.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro vai ao STF contra Janones por xingamentos no Instagram
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) filed a complaint at the Supreme Federal Court (STF) against Deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) for injury, alleging that five Instagram posts between March and June 2024 contained insults such as 'vagabundo', 'idiot', 'fool', and 'worm', forming a pattern of personal attacks unrelated to legitimate political debate. The criminal complaint seeks conviction for five counts of injury, aggravated by the victim being a public official and the offense occurring via social media, plus moral damages of at least R$ 20,000 to be donated to a charitable institution.

item.title: Tarcísio mobiliza equipes para resgates na Venezuela
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas deployed firefighters and Civil Defense teams to Venezuela to support rescue operations after an earthquake that left 920 dead. The humanitarian effort was announced on Friday, March 26, to assist victims of the disaster that occurred on Wednesday, March 24.

item.title: Jaques Wagner reclama de 'patacoada' da PF contra ele, admite relação com sócio do Master e nega que tenha gerado crise a Lula
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner (PT) criticized the Federal Police for publishing images of cash found at an address linked to him, calling the operation a 'patacoada' and comparing it to Lava-Jato tactics. He acknowledged knowing Augusto Lima, a former partner of Banco Master, from the Cesta do Povo privatization process, but denied any commercial relationship or improper benefit. Wagner believes the investigation will not affect President Lula and says he will continue his Senate pre-candidacy, despite stepping down from the government leadership in Congress.

item.title: Novo tremor de magnitude 4.9 é sentido na Venezuela
item.description: A 4.9-magnitude earthquake struck northern Venezuela on June 26, 2026, two days after two major quakes of 7.2 and 7.5 magnitude that left 920 dead and 3,360 injured. The tremors were felt in four Brazilian northern capitals, prompting Brazil to send a humanitarian search-and-rescue mission, while the Foreign Ministry confirmed two Brazilian nationals among the dead.

item.title: PF conclui que Flávio Bolsonaro cometeu calúnia contra Lula nas redes
item.description: The Federal Police concluded that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro committed slander against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva by falsely claiming, without evidence, that Lula would be implicated in international drug and arms trafficking, money laundering, and support for terrorists. The findings were sent to the Supreme Federal Court, which will forward the case to the Attorney General's Office for potential prosecution.

item.title: Treta entre Michelle e Flávio faz Valdemar voltar ao Brasil antes do previsto
item.description: PL national president Valdemar Costa Neto returned to Brazil earlier than planned to mediate a conflict between Michelle Bolsonaro and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, which he described as 'very serious' for the party's electoral plans. The tension between the former first lady and the ex-president's son threatens PL unity ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: PF diz que Flávio Bolsonaro cometeu crime de calúnia contra Lula em post sobre Maduro
item.description: The Federal Police concluded that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro committed the crime of slander against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva by falsely attributing to him allegations of international drug trafficking, money laundering, and support for dictatorships in a post made after Nicolás Maduro’s arrest by the U.S. The report, submitted to the STF, states that the senator directly linked Lula to the listed crimes, constituting defamation with knowledge of falsehood. The investigation was initiated in April 2026 upon request from the PGR, following a representation by federal deputy Dandara Tonantzin (PT-MG).

item.title: Grupo Mulheres do Brasil indica nome a Lula
item.description: The Mulheres do Brasil group sent a letter to President Lula proposing businesswoman Dora Gomes, affiliated with the Green Party, as the vice-presidential candidate on the PT's ticket for the Federal District government, led by pre-candidate Leandro Grass. The nomination aims to bring the PT campaign closer to business voters and moderate sectors, strengthening efforts to broaden its electoral base.

item.title: Governo lança nova fase do Celular Seguro em áreas com mais crimes
item.description: The federal government launched a new phase of the Safe Cellphone Program, sending preventive messages to users in high-theft areas, advising on trusted contacts, IMEI checks, and reporting to the BNCR. The National Cellphone Restriction Bank (BNCR), established by presidential decree on June 23, 2026, aggregates data from state police, telecom operators, Anatel, and other agencies to combat device trafficking. The government warns that official communications contain no clickable links, never request personal data or payments via WhatsApp, and can be verified via the blue checkmark on WhatsApp or by forwarding the message to the Gov.br app’s inbox.

item.title: O timing de Michelle Bolsonaro para expor briga com Flávio nas redes sociais
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro released a video exposing a family dispute with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, which garnered over 10 million mentions in just four hours on social media. According to Alek Maracajá, CEO of Ativaweb, the timing was strategically calculated during a peak of digital attention, boosting her image—especially among evangelical voters—with 80% of mentions being favorable. The incident highlights how emotional narrative and precise timing are decisive in digital political communication.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro caluniou Lula, segundo PF
item.description: The Federal Police concluded that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro committed slander against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in a social media post. The final report was sent to Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes and will be analyzed by the Attorney General's Office, which will decide on possible actions.

item.title: Crise com Michelle “já é página virada”, diz Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro said the crisis with Michelle Bolsonaro is 'a page turned' and mentioned visiting his father, Jair Bolsonaro, who has difficult health but is improving. The statement was made before a pilgrimage in Goiás.

item.title: Entenda a criação da Universidade Federal Indígena
item.description: The Federal Indigenous University (Unind), established by Law 15.418 signed in May 2026, will become Brazil’s 70th federal university and begin operations in 2027, offering programs exclusively aligned with Indigenous knowledge and interests. Its creation marks a historic milestone in reparative justice and social inclusion, following decades of stalled efforts since 2010 and a revival in 2024, building on the 1988 Constitutional recognition of Indigenous rights. Experts warn of potential opposition, particularly from agribusiness sectors, which may label the initiative as unnecessary or divisive and challenge its funding.

item.title: TSE encerra capacitação de novos sistemas com adesão de 25 partidos políticos
item.description: The TSE concluded a training workshop on the new CANDex Web and Conta+JE systems, attended by 46 representatives from 25 political parties. Held in Brasília, the event prepares parties for the full migration to online platforms, eliminating local software and physical media for the 2026 General Elections.

item.title: PF conclui que Flávio Bolsonaro cometeu crime de calúnia contra Lula
item.description: The Federal Police concluded that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro committed the crime of slander against President Lula by falsely linking him to drug trafficking and money laundering in a post on X, connecting him to the U.S. arrest of Nicolás Maduro. The PF determined the statement implied Lula would be implicated by Maduro, constituting slander with aggravating circumstances, and forwarded the investigation to the Supreme Court for further action.

item.title: PF conclui que Flávio Bolsonaro cometeu calúnia ao associar Lula a tráfico internacional de drogas
item.description: The Federal Police concluded that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro committed slander by falsely associating President Lula with international drug trafficking, arms trafficking, and money laundering in a social media post. The report was forwarded to the STF for the PGR to decide whether to file charges, with an aggravating factor for offending the President of the Republic.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro apresenta queixa-crime contra Janones por injúria
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) filed a criminal complaint against federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) at the STF, alleging injurious statements in five social media posts made between March and June 2026, using terms such as 'bandit', 'thief', and 'miliciano'. The defense seeks conviction for five counts of injury in continuous delict and a minimum moral damage compensation of R$ 20,000 to be donated to a charity. Janones has previously lost similar lawsuits filed by the PL, including a TSE decision upholding the removal of a post linking Bolsonaro to organized crime.

item.title: “Vou continuar chamando de bandido”, diz Janones sobre Flávio
item.description: Federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) stated he will continue calling Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) a 'bandit', despite being sued for defamation over five Instagram posts. Bolsonaro is seeking Janones' conviction and a minimum fine. The story was first reported by O Antagonista.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro fala em 'página virada' após Michelle expor desentendimento na família
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) said the disagreement with Michelle Bolsonaro, exposed in a video where she claimed to be disrespected and mistreated, is a 'closed chapter', stating he spoke with his father Jair Bolsonaro and is focused on moving forward. He said he tried to contact her before the video was released and invited her to a meeting with conservative female leaders. Michelle said Flávio told her to stay out of party decisions after she opposed a potential PL alliance with Ciro Gomes in Ceará.

item.title: PF pode abrir até três inquéritos para investigar financiamento do filme Dark Horse
item.description: The Federal Police may open up to three investigations into the financing of the film 'Dark Horse', focusing on R$ 61 million transferred by former banker Daniel Vorcaro to Flávio Bolsonaro, with suspicions that part of the funds were directed to Eduardo Bolsonaro in the U.S. and that parliamentary amendments were steered toward companies linked to the film’s production. The case was assigned to STF Minister André Mendonça as rapporteur, despite a request for Alexandre de Moraes to take it. Investigations involve potential quid pro quo and require U.S. cooperation to break banking secrecy.

item.title: Lula defende defesa do Brasil e critica Trump: ‘Está cheio de nego maluco no mundo’
item.description: President Lula defended strengthening Brazil's defense capacity amid global instability, criticizing Donald Trump's remarks about possibly annexing territories such as Greenland and the Panama Canal. He stated that while Brazil does not seek war, it refuses to be caught off guard, emphasizing that the world is experiencing the highest number of conflicts since World War II and that no one respects those who do not respect themselves. Lula linked sovereignty concerns to tensions with the U.S., including the designation of Brazilian criminal groups as terrorist organizations.

item.title: PF conclui que Flávio Bolsonaro caluniou Lula atribuindo crimes como tráfico de drogas e lavagem de dinheiro
item.description: The Federal Police concluded that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro committed the crime of slander by falsely attributing to President Lula crimes such as drug trafficking and money laundering in a post on X in January 2026. The investigation, authorized by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, was opened at the request of the PF with a favorable opinion from the PGR, which found concrete indications of criminal conduct. The PF report has been forwarded to the PGR for analysis, which will decide whether to file charges, request further diligence, or archive the case.

item.title: Em Goiás, Flávio Bolsonaro ameniza clima com Michelle: "Página virada"
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated that his disagreement with former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro is a 'closed chapter', following a meeting with his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, in Goiânia. He avoided naming Michelle directly but emphasized moving forward, wearing a white shirt as a symbol of peace. The comment came two days after Michelle said in a social media video that she felt disrespected by Flávio during a phone call regarding disagreements over the PL’s electoral slate in Ceará.

item.title: Lula critica ausência de Jorginho Mello em eventos: “Nem sei o nome dele”
item.description: President Lula criticized the absence of Santa Catarina Governor Jorginho Mello (PL) from federal government events during a visit to Petrobras offshore support vessel construction sites in Itajaí, stating he 'doesn't even know his name'. The remark reflected dissatisfaction with the governor's lack of participation in federal initiatives in the state.

item.title: STM declara 'indigno' major condenado por homicídio; MPM diz que vítima foi atraída para falsa comemoração de aniversário
item.description: The Superior Military Court (STM) unanimously declared Major Nildo Gonçalves de Souza unworthy of the officer corps after his final conviction for qualified homicide and concealment of a corpse in Amazonas, resulting in the loss of rank and position. The Military Prosecutor's Office argued the killing was premeditated, with the victim lured under the false pretense of celebrating the officer's birthday, and the STM ordered notification to the TSE for recognition of ineligibility under the Clean Record Law.

item.title: AP Exata: Flávio vive seu momento mais positivo nas redes em 45 dias após vídeo de Michelle
item.description: A video of former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro accusing her stepson, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, of humiliating and mistreating her in a phone call has had an unintended effect, strengthening his social media presence over the past 45 days. Rather than damaging his image, the video sparked sympathy and support from his base, reversing the expected negative impact. This backlash has positioned Flávio in his most favorable online moment of the year so far.

item.title: TJRJ lidera presença de mulheres na magistratura, aponta relatório do CNJ
item.description: The Rio de Janeiro State Court (TJRJ) leads in female representation among Brazil's state judiciaries, with 49% of judges and appellate judges being women — above the national average of 39%. Women constitute a majority (52.9%) in first-instance courts and 61.1% of the court's staff. The CNJ's Justiça em Números 2026 report highlights TJRJ as a top-performing large court in digitalization, territorial coverage, and gender equity.

item.title: Flávio prepara plano para mulheres com foco em proteção e autonomia financeira
item.description: Pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) is preparing a new plan entirely focused on women, emphasizing protection and financial autonomy, following his earlier public safety program with measures directed at women. The plan will be released in the coming days and aims to expand specific policies for women.

item.title: Cleitinho sai em defesa de Michelle Bolsonaro após vídeo contra Flávio
item.description: Senator Cleitinho (Republicanos-MG) defended Michelle Bolsonaro after she released a video claiming she was humiliated and disrespected by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ). Cleitinho condemned unfair attacks from sectors of the right against the former first lady and called for unity among the right against President Lula (PT), emphasizing his leading position in polls for the Minas Gerais governorship in 2026.

item.title: "Vou continuar chamando de bandido", diz Janones após ação de Flávio
item.description: Federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) stated he will continue calling Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) a 'bandit', 'miliciano', and 'thief', despite the criminal complaint filed by Bolsonaro at the STF for defamation. Janones defended his remarks as free speech and vowed to escalate attacks during the 2026 electoral campaign, including reviving the Marielle Franco case to allege Bolsonaro family involvement in her murder.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Disputa entre Flávio e Michelle traz Valdemar de Miami
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto plans to return to Brazil to mediate the dispute between Michelle Bolsonaro and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, aiming to contain the internal crisis within the Bolsonarist camp. The discussion took place on the 'Papo Antagonista' program, where his potential return from Miami was seen as a move to strengthen group unity.

item.title: Bastidores: PT pede que nova líder do governo leve a Lula necessidade de conversa com Alcolumbre
item.description: The PT urged new government Senate leader Teresa Leitão (PT-PE) to convey to President Lula the party's concern over the stalled 6x1 workweek PEC in the Senate, due to Senate President Davi Alcolumbre's failure to bring the matter forward. Lawmakers fear the delay jeopardizes approval before the July 18 legislative recess, undermining electoral use of the issue. PT senators seek consensus to avoid text changes that would require re-submission to the Chamber, and await a Lula-Alcolumbre meeting to unblock the agenda.

item.title: Leia a íntegra da carta de Marco Rubio para Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio rejected Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s request for the U.S. to abandon proposed 25% tariffs on Brazilian goods, despite praising Bolsonaro’s support for designating criminal groups as terrorists. Rubio stated that U.S. trade investigations continue to identify irregular Brazilian practices and that sanctions decisions rest with the USTR, led by Jamieson Greer. He reaffirmed U.S. concerns over digital commerce, Pix, intellectual property, ethanol access, and illegal deforestation.

item.title: Flávio vive seu momento mais positivo nas redes em 45 dias após vídeo de Michelle, aponta AP Exata
item.description: A video by former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro, in which she accused her stepson Flávio Bolsonaro of humiliating and mistreating her, led to a significant increase in positive mentions of the senator on social media, rising from 32% to 38.44% in 45 days, according to AP Exata. Confidence in Flávio also improved, increasing from 11.63% to 13.9%, reversing part of the decline caused by earlier controversies such as the Master case. Although Michelle’s media exposure grew from 5% to 20.9% of mentions, her image remained stable, while Flávio succeeded in mobilizing his base and attracting moderate supporters who viewed the public family dispute as unnecessary.

item.title: Cotado como candidato de Flávio Bolsonaro em Minas, Cleitinho sai em defesa de Michelle
item.description: Senator Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos-MG), tipped as Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL) potential candidate for Minas Gerais governor in 2026, defended former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro amid attacks from sectors of the right. His stance reinforces the alliance between the Bolsonaro clan and conservative figures in Minas Gerais, suggesting a possible candidacy grounded in family legacy support.

item.title: Personalidades se mobilizam contra privatização do Memorial da América Latina
item.description: Personalities, artists, and researchers will launch on Tuesday (30) the SOS Memorial movement to defend the Memorial of Latin America, in response to a proposal by the government of Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) to privatize the site. The movement aims to mobilize civil society to prevent the privatization of this cultural landmark, considered a heritage of Latin America.

item.title: Michelle x Flávio Bolsonaro: veja todos os capítulos do último embate entre os dois
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro accused her stepson Flávio Bolsonaro of humiliating and disrespecting her in a phone call after she criticized the Ceará PL's support for Ciro Gomes, causing strain on his pre-candidacy. Flávio initially downplayed the conflict during a live stream tied to the Brazil match, but later apologized after the game. The family feud unfolds as Flávio's pre-campaign struggles to recover from leaked audio in which he asked Daniel Vorcaro for money.

item.title: Bolsonaro tem picos de pressão alta durante a semana, diz boletim médico
item.description: Former President Jair Bolsonaro experienced moderate spikes in blood pressure throughout the week, managed with additional medication doses, according to a medical bulletin submitted to the STF. Treatment for recurrent and prolonged hiccups remains unchanged, though side effects such as daytime drowsiness and balance instability persist. His lungs still show sequelae from pneumonia contracted in March, and he remains under monitored house arrest due to his 27-year-and-three-month sentence for attempting a coup d'état.

item.title: Fim da 6x1: Alcolumbre vai se reunir com parlamentares governistas para debater PEC
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre will meet next Wednesday with government-aligned lawmakers to discuss the PEC ending the 6x1 work schedule, a proposal backed by the Lula government to boost his popularity. The meeting will include Senate government leader Teresa Leitão, Senator Paulo Paim, and Deputies Reginaldo Lopes and Erika Hilton, while the PEC’s legislative path remains undetermined, likely starting in the Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ) under Senator Otto Alencar’s leadership.

item.title: Filme elogioso sobre Temer o apresenta como moderado e não ouve PT
item.description: The documentary '963 days', directed by Bruno Barreto, praises Michel Temer's government as moderate and necessary to stabilize Brazil after political and economic crises, emphasizing his reforms and congressional relations, while omitting left-wing criticism and excluding PT interviewees. Screened in a special session for politicians in São Paulo, the film aims to reframe Temer beyond daily political intrigue, though it is criticized for being repetitive, lacking counterpoints, and offering little new insight.

item.title: Marília Campos dobra a aposta em Minas e quer frente ampla do PT com ex-tucano
item.description: Marília Campos, former mayor of Contagem and PT’s pre-candidate for the Senate, intensified her campaign by meeting with Gabriel Azevedo (MDB), a former Tucano, and Jarbas Soares (PSB) in Montes Claros to build a center-left coalition in Minas Gerais. Azevedo, despite criticizing the PT and refusing to wear the MST cap, expressed willingness to support Lula and join Campos’ ticket while preserving his political independence. The move responds to Lula’s push for a PT gubernatorial candidate, which Campos opposes in favor of running for Senate.

item.title: ‘Não foi bom expor isso publicamente’, diz líder da oposição sobre embate entre Michelle e Flávio
item.description: Senator Izalci Lucas (PL-DF), leader of the opposition in Congress, criticized the public exposure of the conflict between Michelle Bolsonaro and Flávio Bolsonaro, stating it was not beneficial for the conservative field. While acknowledging the political damage caused by Michelle’s video, he downplayed its impact, saying internal disagreements are natural and tend to be overcome during the electoral process. Izalci urged the opposition to maintain focus on unity for the 2026 presidential race, avoiding personal conflicts from overshadowing the group’s political project.

item.title: Lula critica Jorginho Mello por não ir em eventos do governo federal
item.description: President Lula criticized Santa Catarina Governor Jorginho Mello (PL) for never attending federal government events, despite being invited, during a visit to Petrobras offshore support vessel works in Itajaí. He accused Mello of avoiding partnerships due to political differences, citing a failed R$ 24 billion infrastructure project. Lula questioned Mello’s intellectual capacity and said his stance harms the interests of Santa Catarina’s population.

item.title: Governo avalia que carta é tentativa de Rubio de legitimar Flávio como interlocutor no tarifaço
item.description: The Brazilian government views Marco Rubio’s letter to Flávio Bolsonaro as an attempt to legitimize the senator as a U.S. trade interlocutor, though Brazil will not attend the July 6 hearing, deeming it unsuitable for official representation. Official negotiations are underway in a working group led by Brazilian Minister Marcio Elias Rosa and USTR chief Jamieson Greer, following Lula’s May 7 visit to Trump. The USTR has concluded its investigation, proposing 25% tariffs on Brazilian goods starting July 15, citing unfair practices including Pix usage, intellectual property, judicial decisions, and deforestation.

item.title: Partidos têm até 30 de junho para entregar prestação de contas anual à Justiça Eleitoral
item.description: Political parties must submit their 2025 annual financial reports by June 30 via the Annual Financial Reporting System (SPCA). The requirement applies to all party organs active at any point during the previous year, regardless of whether they raised funds or received assets. Failure to comply may result in sanctions under the Political Parties Law and TSE Resolution No. 23.604/2019.

item.title: Briga entre Michelle e Flávio Bolsonaro perde força nas redes sociais
item.description: The fallout from Michelle Bolsonaro's videos criticizing her stepson, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, has weakened on social media this Friday, with interactions dropping 20% compared to the previous day and mentions of the case declining by 68%. Michelle Bolsonaro remains among the top 15 most discussed figures, now ranked 14th on X Brazil, while Flávio Bolsonaro fell from 13th to 23rd. On Facebook and Instagram, interactions rose 7% compared to the prior day, despite the overall decline.

item.title: Temer apresenta documentário '963 dias', que teve dinheiro de fundo ligado a Vorcaro e entrevistas com Tarcísio e Moraes
item.description: The documentary '963 days' about Michel Temer's government premiered in São Paulo, defending his reforms and rejecting the coup narrative against Dilma Rousseff, featuring interviews with allies such as Tarcísio de Freitas and Alexandre de Moraes, but excluding critics like Rodrigo Janot and Workers' Party members. Director Bruno Barreto said he sought 'complex' individuals, not ideological repeats, while Temer praised the film's fidelity, noting it also depicted the 'Fora Temer' protests.

item.title: Jaques Wagner admite relação com Augusto Lima e critica “patacoada” da PF
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) acknowledged his proximity to businessman Augusto Lima, former partner of Banco Master, but denied allegations of illicit favoritism in the Compliance Zero operation. He criticized the Federal Police for publicly releasing photos of cash seized during searches, calling it a "patacoada" and likening it to Operation Lava Jato, and said he had spoken with Lula about the political toll before stepping down as Senate government leader.
